blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Audits of large language model (LLM) extraction from full-length documents report severe unreliability, leaving two questions open: what the failures actually consist of, and whether confidence signals can turn unreliable output into usable output. We run a preregistered, fully frozen evaluation of two new-generation low-cost LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash) with a flagship-tier control (GPT-6.1-Sol) on a public corpus of 354 incident campaigns (315 unique reports, 630 model-report evaluations), scoring extraction quality against gold, confidence calibration, and robustness to single-sentence perturbations. Three findings emerge. (1) Unreliability persists across tiers: micro precision is 0.03-0.34 and verbalized calibration error (ECE) 0.53-0.94 across both splits; the gap does not close at the flagship tier. (2) The dominant failure is not hallucination: a full mention census plus a three-tier annotation of 360 sampled candidates (two independent LLM annotators from vendors outside the evaluated set, Cohen's kappa = 0.79 on the preregistered acceptance line, fully disclosed) back-projects to 65.6% background mentions and 19.9% gold-scope gaps, with only 1.2% unsupported candidates. (3) Confidence ranks but does not verify: zero-cost self-consistency-frequency tiering passes a preregistered top-30% precision-gain bar in all six test-split model-type cells (4/6 on train), the zero-cost text-frequency x SC frequency combination wins 3, ties 2, loses 1 across cells, yet relation-level counterfactuals on all 45 targets show that a single misattribution sentence flips high-confidence judgments in 95.6-100% of cases, and even a background sentence explicitly marked as unrelated still binds a fake vulnerability in up to 26.7% of them. We conclude with a deployment boundary: confidence tiering may set review priorities, never truth.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When large language models (LLMs) fail at information extraction, the failures are commonly attributed to hallucination. Auditing 315 unique real-world documents (354 incident campaigns; 630 model–report evaluation runs) under a frozen, preregistered protocol with three-tier verified annotation, we find hallucination accounts for only 1.2% of false positives — 65.6% are background mentions : correct strings extracted from the wrong context. We then ask whether confidence signals can still make such a system usable, and show they rank but do not verify : across all 45 counterfactual targets, a single misattribution sentence flips high-confidence judgments in 95.6–100% of cases, and one background sentence explicitly marked as unrelated still binds a fake vulnerability in up to 26.7%.
blocks.zh: 当大语言模型(LLMs)在信息提取时失败时,失败通常归结为幻觉. 审计了315个独特的真实世界文件(354个事件活动;630个模型 - 报告评估运行),在一个被冻结的、预先登记的协议下,并附有三级经核实的注释,我们发现幻觉只占假阳性的1.2% — — 65.6%是背景参考:从错误上下文中提取的正确字符串。 然后,我们问信心信号是否仍然能够使这种系统发挥作用,并显示它们排位但不能核实:在所有45个反事实目标中,一个错误分配的句子推翻了95.6-100%案件中的高度信任判断,一个明确标注为无关性的背景句子仍然将一种假脆弱性绑在26.7 % 。

blocks.en: These results address a question that outlives any single domain, and the stakes are concrete. LLM-based extraction pipelines for structured threat intelligence claimed 83–97% precision ( Chen et al., 2024 ) ; a critical audit ( Mezzi et al., 2025a ) traced those numbers to toy inputs of 18–106 words and showed that at real scale recall falls below 0.80 and calibration worsens; a reproducibility audit found only 5 of 12 extraction systems re-runnable under their published protocols ( Hakim and Song, 2026 ) . But “unreliable” is a verdict, not a diagnosis — and verbalized confidence is itself severely miscalibrated ( Xiong et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2017 ) . It does not say which part of the pipeline is broken — the model’s faithfulness, the evaluation scope, or the task definition — and it does not say whether the residual uncertainty can be managed. Two questions follow. First, what is the failure made of? Hallucinated content, wrong context, or a mismatch between what the model extracts and what the annotation counts as correct demand different repairs. Second, can confidence make unreliability usable? If high-confidence outputs can be prioritized for scarce human review, an unreliable extractor may still be deployable — unless confidence itself is untrustworthy.
blocks.zh: 这些结果涉及到一个比任何一个领域都久远的问题,利害关系是具体的。 基于LLM的用于结构化威胁情报的提取管道声称精确度为83-97%(Chen等人,2024年);一项批评性审计(Mezzi等人,2025年a)将这些数字追溯到18-106字的玩具输入,表明在实际规模上召回量低于0.80,校准情况恶化;一项可复制性审计发现,12个提取系统中只有5个根据其公布的协议可以重新运行(Hakim和Song,2026年)。 但"不可靠"是判决,不是诊断——而口语化信心本身也是严重误判(Xiong等人,2024;Guo等人,2017). 它没有说管道的哪一部分被打破了——模型的忠诚度,评价范围,或者任务定义——也没有说剩余不确定性是否可以管理. 后二问. 首先,失败的原因是什么? 迷幻的内容,错误的上下文,或者模型提取的内容和注释算作正确的内容之间的不匹配要求不同的修复. 第二,信心能否使不可靠性成为可用? 如果高度自信的产出能够优先用于稀少的人类审查,那么不可靠的提取器仍然可以部署——除非信任本身不可信。

blocks.en: We answer both questions on a testbed chosen for measurement quality rather than topical breadth: cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports, long documents describing intrusion campaigns, from which models must extract three entity types (threat-actor groups, vulnerability identifiers, attack techniques). The domain offers three assets that generic extraction benchmarks rarely combine: a public corpus with gold annotations for 354 campaigns ( Di Tizio et al., 2022 ) , a published critical audit whose protocol and splits we reuse so results are directly comparable ( Mezzi et al., 2025a ) , and a real deployment need — security analysts already triage extracted indicators by confidence, so “usable” has an operational meaning. Our evaluation protocol is explicit and frozen end to end: multiset entity matching with alias equivalence classes, dual confidence proxies (verbalized self-report and self-consistency frequency under 5-sample resampling), preregistered acceptance thresholds, relation-level counterfactual perturbations, and a three-tier annotation study (textual mention / event relevance / relation correctness) on 360 stratified candidates, labeled by two independent LLM annotators from vendors outside the evaluated set with adjudication fully disclosed ( κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 on the borderline-excluded preregistered line).
blocks.zh: 我们在为测量质量选择的试验台上而不是在专题宽度上回答这两个问题:网络威胁情报(CTI)报告、描述入侵活动的长篇文件,模型必须从中提取三种实体类型(威胁-行为者群体、脆弱性识别器、攻击技术)。 这个领域提供了一般提取基准很少结合的三种资产:354项活动(Di Tizio等人,2022年)附有金本位说明的公示书,公布的批判性审计,其协议和我们再利用的结果可以直接比较(Mezzi等人,2025a年),以及真正的部署需要——安全分析员已经通过信任对提取的指标进行分类,因此“可使用”具有操作意义。 我们的评价协议是明确和冻结的结束:与别名等效类匹配的多位实体、双重信任代号(在5-抽样下自我报告和自我一致性频率)、预先登记的接受阈值、关系层面的反事实扰动,以及360个标准候选人的三级注释研究(文字上提及/事件相关性/关系正确性),由两个独立的LLM注释员在经过评价的一套裁定书之外充分披露(在边界线排除的预先登记线上=0.79\kappa=0.79)。

blocks.en: (1) Unreliability persists across model tiers. Micro precision spans 0.03–0.34 against recall of 0.81–0.99; verbalized ECE is 0.53–0.94 across both splits, and a full-scope control at the flagship tier (GPT-6.1-Sol) shows the same pattern (0.63–0.94). (2) The dominant failure is background contamination, not hallucination. 99.7–99.8% of false positives have an explicit textual source in the report; weighted back-projection of the three-tier annotation yields 65.6% background mentions and 19.9% gold-scope gaps against 1.2% unsupported candidates. (3) Confidence signals decompose into separable, entity-type-dependent properties. SC frequency passes a preregistered ranking bar in all six test-split model–type cells (4/6 on train, with both vulnerability cells just under the line); controlling for text frequency, its partial correlation with correctness is significant in 6/6 groups ( r = 0.30 r=0.30 – 0.43 0.43 ); mention strength tracks event centrality for actors while sampling stability tracks correctness for vulnerabilities and techniques. (4) No confidence signal measures truth. A single misattribution sentence flips high-confidence judgments in 95.6–100% of 45 counterfactual targets; verification signals — self-run or third-party — inherit the same blindness; repairs only help when matched to the failure mode, ranking gains transfer to a newer corpus, and thresholds must be recalibrated per corpus.
blocks.zh: (1) 模式层面的不可靠性持续存在。 微精度跨度为0.03-0.34,而召回率为0.81-0.99;口头化的欧洲经委会为0.53-0.94分,旗舰级(GPT-6.1-Sol)的全范围控制模式相同(0.63-0.94)。 (2)主要故障是背景污染,而不是幻觉. 99.7-99.8%的假阳性者在报告中有明确的文字来源;对三级注解的加权反预测结果提到65.6%的背景,19.9%的金镜差距与1.2%的无支持候选人相比。 (3)信心信号分解为可分离的,实体型的依赖属性. SC频率在所有6个测试-分裂模型-类型电池中都通过预先注册的排名栏(列车4/6,两条脆弱电池都位于线下);控制文本频率,其部分与正确性的关系在6/6组中相当显著(r=0.30 r=0.30–0.43 0.43);在取样稳定性跟踪脆弱性和技术正确性的同时,提到强度轨道事件的核心作用。 (4) 无信任信号衡量真相。 在45个反事实目标的95.6-100%中,一个错误分配的句子推翻了高度自信的判断;核查信号 — — 自我运行或第三方 — — 继承了同样的失明;修理只有在与失败模式匹配时才有帮助,将收益转移到新的实体中,阈值必须重新调整。

blocks.en: This is a systematic evaluation study: model choices and prompting configurations are experimental settings, ranking heuristics are baselines, error analysis and counterfactuals are the core explanation, and repair experiments serve the boundary characterization. The contributions are three: • A reproducible reliability measurement. To our knowledge (as of 2026-10, within audited coverage), the first evaluation framework merging multiset PRF with alias equivalence classes, dual-proxy calibration, three-tier evidence annotation, and preregistered thresholds into one explicit, frozen protocol — executed on the public audit corpus as a direct response to the reproducibility audit above. All protocol, code, and frozen evaluation outputs accompany this preprint and will be made public; an anonymized copy is additionally available to reviewers as supplementary material. • A quantified failure-mode decomposition. A full-scope mention census plus a preregistered three-tier annotation study locating 85.5% of the false-positive mass in background mentions and gold-scope gaps, against 1.2% hallucination — reframing “LLMs hallucinate entities” as “LLMs over-attend to context”. • A tested deployment boundary. Evidence across confidence signals from self-report to third-party verifiers that ranking benefit is real, signal–type matching matters, calibration scope matters, and no tested signal survives relation-level counterfactuals; ranking gain transfers to a newer corpus while thresholds must be recalibrated.
blocks.zh: 这是一种系统的评价研究:模型选择和提示配置是实验设置,排名heuristic是基线,错误分析和反事实是核心解释,修复实验服务于边界特征. • 可复制的可靠性测量。 据我们所知(截至2026-10年,在审计范围内),第一个评价框架将多套方案成果框架与别名等同类、双代用校准、三级证据说明和预先登记的阈值合并成一个明确、冻结的协议——在公共审计机构上执行,作为对上述可复制审计的直接反应。 所有协议、代码和冻结的评价产出都附在本预印本之后,并将予以公布;还有一份匿名副本作为补充材料提供给审查人员。 • 量化的故障模式分解。 一项全面的普查加上一项预先登记的三级注释研究,在背景中发现85.5%的假阳性质量和金镜差距,而幻觉率为1.2%——将“LLMs幻觉实体”称为“LLMs超视环境”。 • 测试部署边界。 从自我报告到第三方核查者之间的信心信号显示,排名的好处是真实的,信号-类型匹配事项,校准范围事项,没有经过测试的信号能幸存关系层面的反事实;排名收益转移到了新实体,而阈值必须重新调整。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Classical calibration is measured by ECE and reliability curves ( Guo et al., 2017 ) ; for LLMs, verbalized confidence is often miscalibrated ( Xiong et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2023 ) , sampling consistency carries partial signal ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ) , and selective prediction formalizes the risk–coverage trade-off our tiering analysis instantiates ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) . We add a three-way distinction — output consistency , ranking benefit , and probabilistic calibration are different quantities that must not be conflated — and test all three against counterfactual ground truth.
blocks.zh: 经典校准由ECE和可靠性曲线(Guo等人,2017年)测量;对LLMS来说,口服置信度常被误判(Xiong等人,2024年;Tian等人,2023年),采样一致性带有部分信号(Wang等人,2023年;Kadavath等人,2022年),选择性预测将风险 - 覆盖权衡 - 我们的分级分析即时反应(Geifman和El-Yaniv,2017年)正规化. 我们增加一个三方面区分——输出一致性,排名效益,概率校准是不同的数量,不能混为一谈——并对照反事实的地面真理来检验这三方面.

blocks.en: Structured extraction from CTI reports attracted rapid LLM adoption ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Mouiche and Saad, 2026 ; Bouchiha and Blanc, 2026 ) alongside benchmarks ( Alam et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2024 ; Alam et al., 2025 ; Ryan et al., 2026 ; Valletta et al., 2026 ) and corpora ( Di Tizio et al., 2022 ; Ech-Chammakhy et al., 2025 ; Das et al., 2026 ) . A critical audit ( Mezzi et al., 2025a ) overturned headline extraction numbers by exposing scoring loopholes and finding LLMs unreliable with overconfidence; follow-ups target pipeline dependencies ( Berriche et al., 2026 ) , automated TTP and strategic-intelligence extraction ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Ech-Chammakhy et al., 2026 ) , agentic KG construction ( Li et al., 2026 ) , calibrated verification services ( Vasan et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) , and corpus fragmentation ( Suarez-Roman et al., 2026 ) . Reproducibility audits question KG-construction pipelines ( Dinis et al., 2025 ; Hakim and Song, 2026 ) , and systems such as CTINexus ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) have been re-examined under stricter scoring; Chen et al. (2024) systematizes the application landscape. Our work is a systematic evaluation study on the audit’s own public corpus: we reuse its splits for comparability, and extend the audit line from “unreliable” to a measured, preregistered account of what the unreliability consists of and where confidence helps.

blocks.en: Prior CTI work reports misses, over-extraction, and misbinding qualitatively ( Alam et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Mezzi et al., 2025b ; Heo et al., 2026 ) . We quantitatively decompose false positives into mention-level and event-level layers with a preregistered three-tier annotation, and separate hallucination (1.2%) from background contamination (65.6%) and gold-scope gaps (19.9%).

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Task, corpus, and models
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 任务、文书和模式

blocks.en: Given a full-length CTI report, the model extracts three entity types: threat-actor groups (APT), vulnerability identifiers (CVE), and attack techniques (AV, MITRE ATT&CK-style names ( Strom et al., 2020 ) ). We use the public Di Tizio corpus ( Di Tizio et al., 2022 ) under the exact campaign-level 70/30 split of the critical audit ( Mezzi et al., 2025a ) : 354 campaigns (248 train / 106 test at campaign level), 315 train and 93 test reports per model — the same report split reused for both models, for 630 model–report runs in total; Table 1 reports the test split. Gold follows the corpus’s STIX 2.1 structure ( OASIS, 2021 ) and marks primary entities per campaign. We evaluate two new-generation low-cost models (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash — the cheapest “flash” service tiers of their vendors) as subjects and GPT-6.1-Sol as a flagship-tier full-scope control; all runs use frozen prompts, segmentation (cap 40k tokens, overlap 800), temperature-0 extraction with 5-sample self-consistency (SC) resampling (T = = 0.7) per segment. Every reported number is regenerated from frozen batch outputs; the pipeline records gateway and model identity per call (6,048 used segment-level calls on the main table; full call/token accounting in the appendix).
blocks.zh: 鉴于一份完整的CTI报告,该模型摘录了三种实体类型:威胁-行为方组(APT),脆弱性识别器(CVE)和攻击技术(AV, MITRE ATT&CK型名称(Strom等人,2020年))。 我们使用公众的Di Tizioaural(Di Tizio 等人,2022年)在关键审计(Mezzi 等人,2025年a)的准确的70/30分法下:354次运动(248次列车/106次运动测试),315次列车和93份试验报告,同一份报告将两种模型的重复使用,共630份模型报告;表1报告了试验分裂情况。 Gold遵循了该实体的STIX 2.1结构(OASIS, 2021年), 我们评价两个新一代的低成本模型(Deep Seek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash——其供应商最便宜的“flash”服务级)为主体,GPT-6.1-Sol为旗舰级全镜控制;所有运行均使用冷冻导流,分解(40k级令牌,重叠800),以5-样本自相容性(SC)再生(T===0.7)的温度-0提取. 每个报告的数字都是从冻结的批量产出、管道记录网关和每次呼叫的模型身份(主表中6,048次使用了分区级呼叫;附录中的完整呼叫/盘点核算)中重新生成的。

blocks.en: 3.2 Scoring and confidence signals
blocks.zh: 3.2 计分和信心信号

blocks.en: Predictions and gold are matched as multisets under type-specific normalization: alias equivalence classes with word/digit boundaries (APT), fault-tolerant CVE regexes covering PDF mojibake separators and legacy CAN- prefixes, and a conservative 13-value AV synonym table. This counts every mention as a prediction while gold lists primary entities — a deliberately strict-on-the-model scope whose FP semantics is disambiguated by the annotation study (§ 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 预测和黄金在类型特定正常化下被配为多集:别名等值类与词/数字边界(APT),容错的CVE regexs涵盖PDF mjibake分隔器和遗留的CAN前缀,保守的13值AV同义词表. 这把每一个提法都算作一种预测,而金子则列出主要实体——一个刻意严格在模型上的范围,其FP语义因注释研究而变得模糊不清(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: (1) Verbalized : the model’s self-reported 0–100 confidence; (2) SC frequency ( sc_freq ): the share of 5 resamples reproducing the entity — a zero-extra-cost measure of output consistency; (3) text frequency : the count of the entity string in the report, a black-box signal requiring no logits. Their rank-percentile mean forms the zero-cost combination textfreq_sc ; two external verifiers (self-verification and a third-party calibrated decision model) are evaluated against these in § 4.4 .
blocks.zh: (1) 口服:模型自报的0-100置信度;(2) SC频率(sc_freq): (b) 文本频率:报告内实体字符串的计数,一个不需要对数的黑盒信号。 他们的等级-百分率平均值构成零成本组合文本freq_sc;两个外部核查员(自我核查和第三方校准决定模型)在§4.4中对照这些评价.

blocks.en: Before evaluation we registered: a tiering bar (top-30% confidence-bucket precision ≥ \geq overall + 0.10 +0.10 ), an annotation agreement line ( κ ≥ 0.7 \kappa\geq 0.7 ), and a hypothesis register (H1–H6) separating measured claims from pending ones. Failing a registered bar must be restated as a negative result.
blocks.zh: 在评估前,我们登记了:一个分级栏(上- 30%的置信桶精度=\geq 总体+ 0. 10+ 0. 10),一个注释协议线( ^ 0. 0. 7\ kappa\ geq 0. 7),以及一个假说登记册( H1- H6) , 将已计量的索赔与待处理的索赔分开。 未注册的酒吧必须作为负面结果予以重报。

blocks.en: 3.3 Three-tier annotation of sampled candidates
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 抽样候选人的三级说明

blocks.en: To separate what the model extracted from what the annotation counts , all evaluation units of the test split were partitioned by a deliberately lenient mention detector into TP / FP-mentioned / FP-unsupported, and a 360-row stratified subsample (60 per model × \times type; the FP-unsupported stratum fully sampled, the rest balanced across SC-frequency tertiles) was labeled on three tiers: L1 textual mention (does the string appear), L2 event relevance (does it belong to this incident, not background or related work), L3 relation correctness (is the binding and attribution right). The second-annotator role was filled by two independent LLMs (kimi-k3, minimax-m3; neither vendor is among the evaluated models ) under a frozen prompt with temperature 0 and golden-item gating; 36 hard disagreements went to a third adjudicator model and 27 borderline items to a conservative rule resolving toward the model-unfavorable side. Agreement is κ L ​ 2 = 0.68 \kappa_{L2}=0.68 three-class, 0.79 excluding borderline (meeting the preregistered 0.7 line), κ L ​ 3 = 0.74 \kappa_{L3}=0.74 . Stratified sampling weights back-project row-level statistics to the full FP composition (§ 4.2 ). The mechanism is disclosed as LLM-assisted dual annotation throughout — never as two human annotators.
blocks.zh: 为了将模型从注解中提取出来的内容区分开来,测试拆分的所有评价单位都被故意宽松的提及检测器分割成TP / FP / FP 不支持,还有360 row 分层的子样本(每个模型×\\时型60;FP 不支持的层层完全采样,其余的平衡跨SC频率三角)被标注在三个层次上:L1文本提及(是否出现字符串),L2事件相关性(是否属于这一事件,不是背景或相关工作),L3关系正确性(是约束性和归属权). 第二个注释者角色由两个独立的有限责任公司(Kimi-k3, midmax-m3;两个销售商都不在被评价的模型中)填补,它们被冻结在0温度和金质物品Gating的速报下;36个硬分歧投向第三个裁决人模型,27个边缘项目投向保守规则,解决模式不利方面。 协议为L 2 = 0.68\kappa = L2 = 0.68 3级,0.79不包括边线(满足预先注册的0.7线), ^ L 3 = 0.74\kappa+L3+0.74 . 分级采样将项目行级统计权重推至全部FP组成(第4.2节)。 该机制在整个过程中被披露为LLM协助的双重注释——从不作为两个人的注释.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Finding 1: extraction remains unreliable at every tier
blocks.zh: 4.1 调查结果1:采掘工作在各个级别上仍然不可靠

blocks.en: Table 1: Multiset entity-extraction PRF, test split (train-split rows are analogous; appendix). High recall with low precision is structural: the models find most gold entities but drown them in extra candidates (GLM-5.3-Flash test emits 15.1 CVE strings per report on average against at most 2 gold primary CVEs).
blocks.zh: 表1:多集实体-提取PRF,测试拆分(列车-分割行相似;附录). 低精度的高召回是结构性的:模型发现大多数金矿实体,但将其淹没在额外的候选物中(GLM-5.3-Flash测试发出15.1 CVE字符串每份报告平均比起最多2个金矿初级CVE).

blocks.en: Table 1 shows the structural signature: recall across types is 0.81–0.99 while micro precision is 0.06–0.34. The models “find” most gold entities — primary-entity coverage is 0.60–0.95 — but bury them under 10 10 – 20 × 20\times extra strings. Calibration is worse: mean verbalized confidence sits at 80–90+ against unit-level accuracy of 0.05–0.32, and test-split verbalized ECE reaches 0.59–0.88 (CVE: 0.84–0.94), more severe than the critical audit’s zero-shot scope ( Mezzi et al., 2025a ) . The flagship control replicates the pattern (micro P 0.057 / R 0.899 on CVE; ECE 0.63–0.94; APT macro-F1 0.684 statistically indistinguishable from DeepSeek-V4-Flash’s 0.675): upgrading the model tier does not close the reliability gap . SC frequency, by contrast, is a markedly better probabilistic-calibration proxy at zero extra cost (CVE ECE 0.16–0.21 vs verbalized 0.84–0.94); on risk–coverage (AURC), however, the advantage narrows to 4/6 on the GLM-5.3-Flash side — ranking benefit and probabilistic calibration are separable properties (§ 4.4 ). The critical audit’s higher CVE precision (0.67–0.72) comes from a stricter primary-only matching scope; differently-scoped numbers are never placed in one table.
blocks.zh: 表1显示了结构特征:各类召回为0.81-0.99,而微精度为0.06-0.34。 “找到”大多数黄金实体的模型——主要实体的覆盖率为0.60-0.95——但将它们埋在10-10-20x20x20x20x多弦。 校准更糟糕的是:平均口语化的置信度为80-90+,单位级准确度为0.05-0.32,测试分解的ECE为0.59-0.88(CVE:0.84-0.94),比批判性审计的零射程(Mezzi等人,2025a)更严重。 旗舰控制复制模式(微波P 0.057 / R 0.899 on CVE;ECE 0.63–0.94;APT macro-F1 0.684 在统计上与DeepSeek-V4-Flash的0.675无法区分):升级模式级并不弥补可靠性差距。 相比之下,SC频率是以零额外成本(CVE ECE 0.16-0.21 vs 口头化0.84-0.94)为明显更好的概率校准代用;然而,在风险掩蔽(AURC)方面,优势缩小到GLM-5.3-Flash方面的4/6——排名收益和概率校准是可分离属性(第4.4节)。 批评性审计的CVE精度较高(0.67–0.72),来自于更严格的一级匹配范围;不同范围的数字从未放在一个表格中.

blocks.en: 4.2 Finding 2: failures are background contamination, not hallucination
blocks.zh: 4.2 调查结果2:失败是背景污染,而不是幻觉

blocks.en: A full-scope mention census over all evaluation units — type-adaptive, deliberately lenient detection so that “unsupported” is a lower bound — shows that 99.7% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) / 99.8% (GLM-5.3-Flash) / 99.7% (GPT-6.1-Sol) of CVE false positives have an explicit textual source in the report; unsupported output is at most 0.2–11.2%. The three-tier annotation (Table 2 ) turns this census into an event-relevance-layer quantification: back-projected by sampling weights, 85.5% of the full FP composition (across all three entity types) is background mentions (65.6%) plus gold-scope gaps (19.9%) — entities the report genuinely mentions and that are event-relevant, but which fall outside the primary-entity gold set — while unsupported phantom candidates are only 1.2% (the unweighted 10.3% is inflated by the fully-sampled stratum). Confidence separates the FP mass by nature: rows in the high SC-tertile are event-relevant in 62% of cases (mostly scope mismatch — the model got the event right, gold does not include it) versus 26% in the low tertile, while 23% of high-confidence gold rows are judged not event-relevant — the scope gap is bidirectional (gold itself has boundaries). The same decomposition holds on a newer 2022–2025 corpus (annotation-derived gold, κ = 0.53 \kappa=0.53 borderline-excluded — Limitations), where relation-level errors ( L3=no ) are entirely absent and FPs are again dominated by background mentions (51.2%). Relation-level KG alignment completes this picture: aligning extracted relation triples against the gold graph yields F1 of only 0.05–0.33 (flagship CVE P 0.049 / R 0.750 / F1 0.092 — precision below both flash tiers with recall on par), because one extra entity is one FP at the entity level but a spurious edge at the graph level — graph quality must be scored at the relation level , not by entity counts or visual inspection.
blocks.zh: 对所有评价单位进行全面的普查——类型适应性、刻意宽大检测,使“不支持”成为较低的约束范围——显示99.7%(深Seek-V4-Flash)/99.8%(GLM-5.3-Flash)/99.7%(GPT-6.1-Sol)的CVE假阳性物在报告中有明确的文字来源;不支持的输出最多为0.2-11.2%。 三级注释(表2)将这次普查变成事件-相关层定量:根据抽样权重进行背推,在全部FP组成(在所有三个实体类型中)中,85.5%的背景是提及(65.6%)加上金镜差距(19.9%)——报告真正提及且与事件相关但不属于初级实体黄金组合的实体——而无支持的幽灵候选人仅占1.2%(未加权的10.3%被充分取样的层层充气)。 自信将FP质量按性质区分:高SC-tertile中的行在62%的案例中与事件相关(大多数是范围不匹配——模型对事件正确,黄金不包含它),而在低tertile中则为26%,而高自信金行23%被判定与事件无关——范围差距是双向的(黄金本身有边界). 同样的分解方式也适用于较新的2022–2025项(注解衍生的黄金, ob = 0.53\kappa = 0.53 边线排除的-限制),其中完全没有关系级错误(L3= 否),FP再次被背景引用(51.2%)。 关系级KG对齐完成此图:将提取的关系三重比对金图只得出0.05-0.33的F1(旗舰CVE P 0.049 / R 0.750 / F 1 0.092 ——精确度低于两个闪光级,同时在平面上召回),因为一个额外的实体是实体一级的一个FP,但在图面上是一个虚假的边缘——图形质量必须在关系级别上得分,而不是通过实体的计数或视觉检查.

blocks.en: Table 2: Three-tier failure-mode distribution on the 360-row stratified subsample, all three entity types (w% = back-projected to the full FP composition via sampling weights; the top rows are FP-composition shares). Relation misbinding is a 1-row residual in natural output.
blocks.zh: 表2:360row分层子样本上的三级故障模式分布,所有三种实体类型(w% = 通过采样权重背向完整的FP组成;顶端行为FP-组合股份). 关系错联是自然产值的一行残值.

blocks.en: The reading is blunt: the reliability problem of modern LLM extraction on long documents is not a faithfulness problem. The models almost never invent entities; they report strings whose truth they cannot adjudicate against this event — “mentioned” is mistaken for “used”. Repairs and deployments should therefore target context disambiguation and review prioritization, not factuality.
blocks.zh: 读法是钝的:在长文件上提取现代LLM的可靠性问题不是一个忠实问题. 这些模型几乎从未发明实体;它们报告它们不能对这一事件作出裁定的串线——“上述”被误认为“被使用”。 因此,修理和部署应针对情况,造成混乱,并审查优先次序,而不是事实。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evidence faithfulness: outputs are weakly anchored to their own evidence
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 证据的可靠性:产出薄弱于本身的证据

blocks.en: Beyond entity strings, the protocol scores a three-tier evidence hit rate (EHR): whether the segment carrying an extraction actually contains the evidence it claims, at graded evidence-similarity thresholds. EHR is low overall (macro 0.19–0.51 across models, splits, and thresholds: test-split @0.95 = 0.235 GLM-5.3-Flash / 0.371 DeepSeek-V4-Flash / 0.396 GPT-6.1-Sol), with DeepSeek-V4-Flash’s evidence sentences leading GLM-5.3-Flash’s by about + 0.14 +0.14 — the evidence-capability gap exceeds the extraction-capability gap, and even the flagship stays below 0.5. The cause is a value-vs-sentence misalignment (models emit canonical technique names where reports use natural-language descriptions; decomposition in the appendix), and the scope is verbatim-anchored, stricter than and incomparable to RAGAS-style faithfulness — explanation reliability is the current weak spot of LLM extraction , independent of entity precision.
blocks.zh: 除了实体字符串之外,协议对三级证据命中率(EHR)进行评分:承载提取的段是否实际包含其声称的证据,分级为证据-等同阈值. EHR整体水平较低(跨型号,分数和阈值的宏0.19–0.51:测试-split@0.95=0.235 GLM-5.3-Flash / 0.371 DeepSeek-V4-Flash / 0.396 GPT-6.1-Sol),DeepSeek-V4-Flash的证据句导致GLM-5.3-Flash的分数约为+0.14+0.14——证据能力差距超过提取能力差距,甚至旗舰停留在0.5以下. 其原因是价值-vs-判罚错位(模型释放出犬科技术名称,报告使用自然语言描述;在附录中分解),范围是逐字排列的,比RAGAS式的忠诚更为严格,且不可比拟——解释可靠性是目前LLM提取的弱点,独立于实体精度.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Coverage–accuracy curves of confidence tiering (test split): rows are GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash; columns are APT / CVE / AV. Orange circles: verbalized self-report; blue squares: SC frequency; gray dotted: overall accuracy. SC-frequency tiering is steep and monotone (e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash APT precision 0.500 at 30% coverage vs overall 0.321); verbalized is nearly flat (97%+ of self-reports pile into 80–100).
blocks.zh: 图1 覆盖度-精确度的置信级曲线(测试分割):行为GLM-5.3-Flash和DeepSeek-V4-Flash;列为APT / CVE / AV. 橙色圆:口头自报;蓝色方块:SC频率;灰色点:整体精度. SC频率的分级是陡峭的和单质的(例如,深度Seek-V4-Flash APT精度为0.500,覆盖率为30%,总体为0.321);口语化几乎是平的(97+%+的自报堆积成80-100)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Finding 3: confidence signals decompose — and rank, not verify
blocks.zh: 4.4 调查结果3:信任信号分解——分级,不核查

blocks.en: Table 3: Unified-candidate-set ranking baselines, test split: top-30% precision gain against the preregistered + 0.10 +0.10 bar (random = 200 seeds ± \pm sd). The zero-cost combination textfreq_sc (omitted column; Fig. 2 ) wins 3, ties 2, loses 1 of 6 cells; the flagship tier confirms the mechanism at textfreq_sc + 0.454 +0.454 on APT, the largest value across all 9 combinations.
blocks.zh: 表3:统一冠状定型排名基线,测试分数:相对于预先注册的+0.10+0.10条杠(random = 200种子±\pm sd),上至30%的精度增益. 零成本组合 textfreq_sc(oconduction 栏目;图2)胜 3,领带2,损失6个单元格中的1个;旗舰级在 textfreq_sc+0.454+0.454 APT上确认机制,是所有9个组合中最大的值.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Ranking baselines including the zero-cost combination textfreq_sc : on actor entities mention strength measures event centrality; on techniques text frequency is negative while SC works. Red dashed line: preregistered + 0.10 +0.10 bar.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 排名基线,包括零成本组合 textfreq_sc :关于演员实体,提及力量度量事件中心;关于技术,在SC工作期间文本频率为负数. 红色虚线:预注册+0.10+0.10栏.

blocks.en: Three separable properties, three answers. Ranking benefit is real and signal–type matched (Table 3 , Fig. 2 ): SC frequency passes the preregistered bar in all six cells; the zero-cost textfreq_sc combination is the best overall choice (best or tied in 5/6 cells), but text frequency alone hurts on attack techniques (canonical names decoupled from surface phrasing) while SC works — “which confidence proxy is better” is an engineering decision over signal × \times type, not a binary. SC is not a proxy for text frequency : controlling for log ⁡ ( 1 + text_freq ) \log(1{+}\text{text\_freq}) , the partial correlation of SC frequency with correctness is significant in 6/6 groups ( r = 0.30 r=0.30 – 0.43 0.43 , p ≤ 0.0005 p\leq 0.0005 ), while DeepSeek-V4-Flash’s verbalized confidence is fully absorbed (partial r = 0.000 r=0.000 , p = 0.997 p=0.997 ) — self-report is nearly useless as a ranking signal except where it carries event-centrality information (GLM-5.3-Flash-APT, r = 0.187 r=0.187 ). Scope changes calibration verdicts : recomputed on the adjudicated three-tier labels, SC-frequency calibration error shrinks in 5/6 groups (e.g. 0.62 → \to 0.38), because scope-mismatch FPs charged against the main-table scope are recovered as correct event-centrality rankings — verbalized overconfidence, by contrast, is absolute and unaffected. What a review budget buys is type-specific : simulating fixed review budgets in SC-frequency order, a 20% budget on vulnerabilities locks in 96% of correct items (with the head’s selective risk disclosed below), while the actor ranking’s top 5–10% is enriched with errors (11 of the first 13 units are misbinding FPs, density gain negative until a 30% budget) — review-from-the-top fails on actors , and fixed thresholds must be set per type (full budget–benefit tables in the appendix).
blocks.zh: 三分别性三答. 排名福利是真实的,信号类型匹配(表3,图2): SC频率通过所有6个单元格中预先注册的栏;零成本的文本freq_sc组合是最佳的整体选择(最佳或捆绑在5/6单元格中),但文本频率单独伤害攻击技术(canonical name decupled with professional phrassing),而SC工作时——“信任代理更好”是相对于信号x\\time类型的工程决定,而不是二进制. SC不是文本频率的代名词: 控制log QQ (1 + text_freq )\log (1 + text{text_\_freq }),SC频率与正确度的部分相关性在6/6组(r = 0.30 r= 0.30 – 0.43 0.43,p 0.0005 p\leq 0.0005)中是显著的,而Deep Seek-V4-Flash的口语化置信度被完全吸收(部分r = 0.000 r= 0.000,p = 0.997 p= 0.997)——自我报告作为排名信号几乎是无用的,除非载有事件集中信息(GLM-5.3-Flash-APT,r = 0.187 r= 0.187 ) 范围变化判断:在裁定的三级标签上重新计算,SC频率校准误差在5/6组中缩小(e. g. 0.62 → ox 0.38)——因为对事件进行范围充电,以绝对稳定排列,以 审核预算买入的是特定类型:以SC频率顺序模拟固定审核预算,96%的正确项目中20%的弱点锁定预算(下面披露头部的选择性风险),而行为者排名前5-10%的错误(前13个单位中有11个错误约束FP,密度增长负至30%的预算 ) — — 审核从上到上都失败,并且必须设定每个类型的固定门槛(附录中的完整预算-效益表 ) 。

blocks.en: 4.5 Finding 4: none of it verifies truth
blocks.zh: 4.5 调查结果4:没有一项核实事实

blocks.en: Table 4: Relation-level counterfactuals: one injected sentence per report (all 45 targets, both models). Retained high confidence after binding: verbalized 58–98, SC frequency 0.50–0.90.
blocks.zh: 表4: 关系层面的反事实:每份报告一个注入句子(全部45个指标,两个模型). 装订后保持高度信心:口头化58–98,SC频率0.50–0.90.

blocks.en: If confidence measured truth, sentences that change the facts should change the scores. They do not (flash tier; the flagship counterfactual batch was not run, see Limitations). All perturbations are synthetic by construction — injected assertions contradict the facts, gold never updates, and nothing is extrapolated to real retraction or attribution-update streams. Injecting one style-matched sentence per report (Table 4 ): an attribution assertion makes both models rebind the event to an injected organization at high confidence (73.3% / 95.6%); even a sentence explicitly flagged as unrelated to this case still binds a fake vulnerability in 26.7% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) of targets, and every residual binding carries above-average confidence (verbalized 98.1 / SC 0.774). Symmetrically, one retraction sentence erases the true vulnerability from 34.1% / 76.2% of outputs while majority sampling still reproduces it — true and fake entities are symmetric in their exposure to surface text. The fake entity’s mean self-reported confidence (98.0 / 85.6) is indistinguishable from the true entity’s, and its SC frequency is identical across models (0.892): SC frequency measures textual consistency, not fact . Self-verification does not rescue this: DeepSeek-V4-Flash’s verify signal ranks at + 0.154 +0.154 on actors, its “event-related” rate on mentioned FPs (92.5%) matching true entities (93.3%) — it mistakes mention for relevance — while GLM-5.3-Flash’s verifier retains discrimination (87.1% vs. 50.1%; verify alone + 0.371 +0.371 , SC × \times verify + 0.413 +0.413 , the best actor ranker of all signals), and a third-party calibrated decision model (TypeSafe Jev; 1,461 calls, $0.051; protocol and per-call logs in the appendix) shows the same law: its increment depends on whether its window-level judgment semantics align with report-level gold. Across all tested signals — self-report, sampling consistency, self-verification, third-party verification — none survives relation-level counterfactuals : confidence sets review priorities; it must never adjudicate truth, and a verification component earns its place only when the verifier passes a one-shot FP-mentioned event-relevance precheck.
blocks.zh: 如果信心测量了真相,改变事实的句子应该改变分数. 它们没有(闪电级;旗舰反事实批次没有运行,见限制)。 所有扰动都是通过构造合成的——注入的断言与事实相矛盾,黄金从不更新,没有任何东西可以推论为真实的收回或归属的更新流. 每个报告注入一个风格匹配的句子(表4):一种归属论使两个模型都以高度的置信度(73.3%,95.6%)将事件重组给一个被注入的组织;即使明确标注为与本案无关的句子,仍将26.7%的目标(Deep Seek-V4-Flash)的假脆弱性捆绑起来,而每个剩余束缚都携带高于平均水平的置信度(口头化98.1/SC 0.774)。 对称地说,一个收回的句子从34.1%/76.2%的输出中抹去了真正的脆弱性,而大多数采样仍然复制它——真实和假的实体在接触表面文本时是对称的. 假实体的平均自我报告信心(98.0 / 85.6)与真实实体是分不开的,其SC频率在模型上是相同的(0.892): SC频率测量文字一致性,而不是事实. 自我核查并不能挽救这种情况:DeepSeek-V4-Flash的验证信号排在演员的+0.154+0.154, 其匹配真实实体的FP(92.5%)的“事件相关”率(93.5%)——它错误地提到了相关性——而GLM-5.3-Flash的验证者保留了歧视(87.1%对50.1%;单独核查+0.371+0.371;SC ×\time验证+0.413+0.413,所有信号的最佳演员排名),以及第三方校准决定模式(TypeSafe Jev;1 461呼叫,0.051;协议和附录中的每个呼叫日志),都显示同样的法律:其增量取决于其窗口级判断语句是否与报告级黄金一致。 在所有经过测试的信号——自我报告、取样一致性、自我核查、第三方核查——中,没有人能幸存在关系层面的反事实中:信任设定了审查的优先次序;它绝不能裁定真相,核查部分只有在核查员通过一发FP事件相关预查时才能获得其位置。

blocks.en: 4.6 Repair and generalization boundaries
blocks.zh: 4.6 修理和通用边界

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented and chain-of-thought repair helps actors (up to + 0.133 +0.133 macro-F1) and never helps vulnerabilities ( Δ ≤ ± 0.011 \Delta\leq\pm 0.011 , corroborated by an independent dual-gold recheck on a separate CVE corpus ( CIRCL, 2024 ) ); primary-entity schema alignment repairs actor over-extraction only ( + 0.111 +0.111 and + 0.167 +0.167 ) — repairs work when matched to the failure mode, consistent with Finding 2, and gains do not transfer across models (CoT flips sign on attack techniques). On an unfamiliar 2022–2025 corpus (30 group-deduplicated reports, three-tier annotation-derived gold), ranking-gain transfer is confirmed (top-30% gains positive in 6/6 cells, never below the main pool; AURC improves across the board), while fixed thresholds do not transfer: after per-corpus quantile recalibration (unlabeled percentile cut points only), threshold buckets transfer fully for attack techniques (all recalibrated gaps ≤ 0.09 \leq 0.09 ) and, for actors and vulnerabilities, cross-corpus differences are corpus-difficulty-driven with a conservative bias — threshold recalibration is a mandatory deployment step, not an option . Cross-model ranking agreement persists on the new corpus (Spearman 0.63–0.77), and a top-10 report-level audit finds the top SC bucket carries analyst value (8/10 TTP-rich, none low) with no per-report guarantee. The deployable workflow follows: triage in descending textfreq_sc order with per-type budgets — a 20% focused review zone plus tail sampling for vulnerabilities (bucket precision 0.17–0.19 vs overall 0.05–0.06), mandatory human review of the actor head (0.64–0.73 vs overall 0.27–0.32) — protocol reproducibility belongs on review checklists for extraction papers, and tiering prioritizes governance queues while evidence checks gate ingested claims. These are review-simulation figures, not measured human effort (Limitations).
blocks.zh: 回收加固和思维链的修复帮助了行为者(最多+0.133+0.133宏观-F1),从未帮助脆弱性(++ 0.011\Delta\leq\pm 0.011),并得到了独立双金重新检查单独的CVE(CIRCL, 2024)的证实;初级实体的校正修配器只超采(+ 0.11+0.111和+ 0.167+0.167)——在与故障模式匹配时进行修复工作,符合结果2,收益不会跨模型转移(攻击技术的CoT翻转标志)。 在不熟悉的2022–2025个单元(30个小组重复报告,三级注解衍生的黄金)中,排名转移得到确认(在6/6个单元中,最高-30%的数值为正数,不低于主池;AURC全面改善),而固定阈值则不转移:在每家公司重排(仅标为百分点)后,阈值桶完全用于攻击技术的转移(所有重排缺口为0.09\leq 0.09),对于行为者和脆弱性,跨公司差异由保守的偏见驱动——阈值重排是强制性的部署步骤,而不是选择。 跨模式的排名协议在新书中持续(Spearman 0.63–0.77),前10级报告级审计发现最高SC桶载分析师价值(8/10 TTP富含,无低),没有每份报告的保证. 可部署的工作流程如下:按照每类预算对降序的文本freq_sc顺序进行细分——20%的焦点审查区加上尾端取样(桶精度0.17-0.19对总的0.05-0.6),对行为者头进行强制性人力审查(0.64-0.73对总的0.27-0.32)——协议的可复制性属于提取文件的审查清单,分级优先治理队列,同时对证据检查门的索偿进行优先检查。 这些是审查模拟数字,不是衡量人类的努力(限度)。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We turned the “unreliable” verdict on LLM entity extraction into a measured, preregistered account: the dominant failure is background contamination (65.6%) and gold-scope gaps (19.9%), not hallucination (1.2%); confidence signals are real but decompose into consistency, ranking, and calibration — each useful, each type-dependent, none truth-tracking under flash-tier relation-level counterfactuals. The deployable boundary is correspondingly concrete: match the ranking signal to the entity type, recalibrate thresholds per corpus, and treat confidence tiering as review prioritization with humans or independent verifiers retaining truth. All protocol, code, frozen outputs, and annotation artifacts accompany this preprint and will be made public; an anonymized copy is additionally available to reviewers.
blocks.zh: 我们把关于LLM实体提取的“不可靠”判决变成一个经衡量、预先登记的账户:主要失败是背景污染(65.6%)和金镜差距(19.9%),而不是幻觉(1.2%);信任信号是真实的,但分解成一致性、排名和校准——每一个有用、每个类型依赖、没有在闪光级关系级反事实下跟踪真相。 可部署边界相对而言是具体的:将排位信号与实体类型相匹配,重新校准每个实体的阈值,并将信任等级视为与保留真理的人类或独立核查人进行优先审查。 所有协议、代码、冻结产出和注释文物都附在本预印本上,并将予以公布;还有一份匿名副本可供审查人员查阅。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: All absolute numbers come from one domain (threat-intelligence reports) and one gold-annotation convention (primary entities per campaign). We argue the mechanisms (background contamination, signal–type matching, ranks-not-verifies) generalize, and corroborate direction on a newer corpus with independent annotation-derived gold; but cross-domain replication (biomedical, legal, scientific IE) is future work, and absolute precision values are not comparable across annotation scopes.
blocks.zh: 所有绝对数字都来自一个领域(威胁情报报告)和一个金矿通报公约(每次运动的主要实体)。 我们主张将机制(背景污染、信号-类型匹配、排位不核实)概括起来,并用独立的注解衍生的黄金证实新体的方向;但跨域复制(生物医学、法律、科学的IE)是未来的工作,绝对精确值在注解范围上并不可比。

blocks.en: The serving gateways strip log-probabilities, so calibration proxies are signals that require no logits (verbalized + SC frequency), per the preregistered fallback plan; logprob-scope calibration awaits a direct-API environment. Gold covers three entity types — campaign attribution is unscored (free-text names without comparable ground truth). Campaign-to-report alignment covers 88.4% (18 unresolved cross-case surveys and 39 third-party group-level reports remain); no reported number depends on any single alignment, and sensitivity is recomputable from the open scripts. During one ablation round, 15 campaigns were blocked by a vendor content policy on a single channel (figures reported on the joint 84-report scope) — CTI content itself can trigger LLM content policies, a production constraint on direct deployment.
blocks.zh: 服务网关为条日志概率,因此校准代号是不需要日志(verbalized + SC频率)的信号,按照预先注册的倒置计划;日志镜校准等待直接API环境. 黄金涵盖三种实体类型——竞选归属无分数(自由文字名称没有可比的底线真实性). 运动与报告协调涉及88.4%(尚有18个未解决的跨案件调查和39个第三方小组级报告);报告的数字不取决于任何单一协调,敏感度可以从公开的脚本中可比较。 在一个减价回合中,一个渠道上的供应商内容政策(84-报告联合范围的数字)阻止了15项竞选活动——CTI内容本身可以触发LLM内容政策,这是生产对直接部署的限制.

blocks.en: The three-tier labels are produced by two LLM annotators from vendors outside the evaluated set plus a third adjudicator model — disclosed as such throughout, never as two human annotators. Agreement meets the preregistered line ( κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 borderline-excluded) but LLM annotation carries unknown failure modes relative to expert humans; the conservative adjudication rule resolves ambiguity toward the model-unfavorable side, and the generalization-corpus gold (lower κ \kappa , 0.53 borderline-excluded) bounds the confidence of that extrapolation. A human spot-check of a subsample is planned for the revision.
blocks.zh: 三级标签由两个LLM标注员制作,这些标注员来自被评价的套装外的销售商,外加第三个标注员模型——从不作为两个人名标注员被这样披露。 协议符合预先注册的线条(ob = 0.79\kappa = 0.79 边线排除),但相对于专家人类而言,LLM注释带有未知的失败模式;保守裁决规则解决了对模型-不利方的模糊性,泛化-公司金(ob ob =\kappa,0.53 边线排除)约束了该推断的信心. 计划对子样本进行人工抽查,以进行修改.

blocks.en: Subjects are two new-generation low-cost (“flash”-tier) models; the flagship control covers the main table, calibration, and mention census, but not the counterfactual, verification-signal, or generalization batches (cost-prohibitive at flagship rates; scope notes mark every affected table). Conclusions about verification signals are therefore scoped to the flash tier plus one third-party verifier.
blocks.zh: 主体为两款新一代低成本(flash)型号;旗舰控制覆盖主表,校准,并提及普查,但不包括反事实,校验标志,或泛化批次(成本-按旗舰费率禁止;范围说明标注每个受影响的表格). 因此,关于核查信号的结论范围扩大到闪存级加一个第三方核查员。

blocks.en: We never fit a parametric calibrator; ECE/Brier/AURC are measured, not post-hoc corrected. The three-tier recalibration uses a stratified subsample whose absolute values are not comparable to full-scope tables — only the direction of scope sensitivity is claimed.
blocks.zh: 我们从未安装过一个参数计算器;欧洲经委会/布雷尔/欧洲辐射防护中心是经过测量的,而不是经过事后修正的。 三级重排使用分层的子样本,其绝对值不能与全镜表相比——只主张范围敏感方向.

blocks.en: Main-corpus collection ends around 2021; the newer-corpus experiment (§ 4.6 ) partially tests time sensitivity (entity density flat at two-year granularity, ranking consistency preserved), but extrapolating main-table precision and calibration numbers — and any fixed threshold — beyond that distribution demands caution. Keeping the corpus is deliberate: the critical audit’s numbers share its source and split, so the “unreliability not repaired” comparison stands.
blocks.zh: 主公司收集工作在2021年左右结束;新公司实验(§4.6)部分测试时间敏感性(实体密度在两年颗粒度下平坦,排名一致性保留),但推断主表精度和校准数字——以及任何固定阈值——超出该分布范围需要谨慎. 保留审计委托书是故意的:关键审计的数字有其来源,有其分裂,因此, " 不可靠而不修复 " 的比较是站不住脚的。

blocks.en: Following the reproducibility audit (5 of 12 systems re-runnable; F1 drifts of 0.16–0.70 across protocols), we re-execute no third-party pipeline as a same-scope baseline; cross-system numbers are quoted only from the critical audit under an explicitly different scope and never placed in one table with ours — our frozen one-click reproduction addresses the missing baseline at the protocol level rather than the system level.
blocks.zh: 继可复制性审计(12个系统中有5个可重新运行;F1漂移0.16-0.70跨协议)之后,我们重新执行不把第三方管道作为同一范围的基准;跨系统数字只从明确不同范围的关键审计中引用,从未与我们放在一个表格中——我们被冻结的一击复制处理的是协议一级而不是系统一级缺失的基准。

blocks.en: H1–H3 completed as reported (§ 4.2 –§ 4.4 ); H4 completed (§ 4.6 ); H5 completed with scope limits (cost anchors archived, measured human hours future work); H6 completed (§ 4.5 ). Human-efficiency measurement of the analyst triage workflow (as opposed to simulated review budgets) and an independent held-out calibration set remain unexecuted; they are registered as pending, not claimed. Remaining gold-bearing generalization candidates (a STIX 2.1 structured set, CTI-HAL, CyberNER, RAGRecon) are queued for a later stage. A channel interruption during the revision round was fully recovered and disclosed (all batches completed: counterfactuals 1,080/1,080 per model; verification 1,221+1,200 calls with 0 failures; flagship 822/822 with 0 failures); call-level logs are in the repository.

blocks.en: All frozen batch outputs, evaluation code, annotation artifacts (the freeze JSON files with per-item labels and adjudication logs), and the derived gold are released through an anonymized repository for review, public upon acceptance; the report corpus is Zenodo deposit 7357568 (MIT) and the 2022–2025 corpus is the public Hugging Face dataset apt-cti-reports (MIT); redistribution of model outputs is governed by vendor terms.

blocks.en: +RAG : the report’s full text is chunked at 1,000 characters with 100-character overlap; the current segment serves as the BM25 query, the top-6 chunks excluding those overlapping the current segment are concatenated as context — in-report retrieval with no external knowledge (fending off knowledge-cutoff and data-leakage objections). +CoT : the prompt is extended with “first output Reasoning: bullet points ( ≤ \leq 5, citing supporting sentences), then output JSON as the last content”; the parser performs multi-start brace balancing. One extraction per configuration (T = = 0, no SC sampling): the ablation measures single-extraction quality only. Task isolation : ablation task ids are derived independently of the main run, with no mutual overwriting.
